Description:
  Generate a subset solution/build file for incremental CI builds

Usage:
  Meziantou generate [options]

Options:
  -i, --input <input> (REQUIRED)                                 Path to the input file (SLN, SLNX, Traversal SDK, or single project file)
  -o, --output <output> (REQUIRED)                               Path for the output file (SLN, SLNX, or Traversal SDK). Format is inferred from extension.
  --no-output-if-empty                                           Do not write an output file when no projects are affected. If the output file already exists, it is deleted.
  -r, --repository <repository>                                  Path to the git repository (default: current directory) [default: .]
  --head-commit <head-commit>                                    The head commit SHA (default: HEAD)
  --base-commit <base-commit>                                    The base commit SHA (default: auto-detected via merge-base).   --base-branch <base-branch>                                    The base branch for merge-base detection and base commit refinement (default: auto-detected from GitHub Actions PR context or remote)
